name: Confront Lorthuna

angles.text: As a priest, you face High Priestess Lorthuna, a corrupted spiritual leader among the spires. The battle against her carries weight for those who defend against dark doctrine.
As a shaman, you share a spiritual stake in the Windshapers' work to guide elemental balance on Zephras. You can help ensure that harmony survives Lorthuna's threat.

faq.answer: High Priestess Lorthuna is a powerful adversary who flees through a portal to the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale pursue her there.
The Rohashi Spires are heights above the island of Zephras. High Priestess Lorthuna flees there through a portal, and her pursuers follow.
Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger pursue High Priestess Lorthuna through the portal as she flees to the spires. They call for your aid.
faq.q: Who pursued Lorthuna into the portal?

faq.answer: Valennia and her surviving forces need immediate care after the fighting. Healers tend them, and they are escorted to recover in the High Elder's residence.
faq.q: What happened to Valennia and her forces?

faq.answer: Muln is an ally associated with the Windshapers who departs for mainland Azeroth after discussing their future and continuing mission.
faq.q: What is Muln's role in these events?

faq.answer: Zephras remains critically vulnerable after the confrontation. Its leaders must urgently plan defenses against the dangers threatening the island.
faq.q: Is the island of Zephras safe after Lorthuna is confronted?

sections.body: High Priestess Lorthuna flees through a mystic gateway into the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. An injured ally remains behind at the portal's threshold. Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger follow her into the heights and call for your help before she escapes justice or strengthens her power.
sections.title: Pursuit into the Spires

sections.body: After the clash in the spires, Valennia and her surviving forces need a healer's care. They are escorted to recover within the High Elder's residence. Lorthuna has met them in combat, and the coalition is battered with its resources stretched thin.
sections.title: The Cost of the Battle

sections.body: After the battle, Muln confers on the Windshapers and their continuing mission, then departs for mainland Azeroth. Zephras remains critically vulnerable. The leaders left behind must urgently plan defenses against the dangers that still threaten the island.
sections.title: An Island Left Vulnerable

summary: Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger pursue High Priestess Lorthuna through a portal into the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. They call for your aid before she can escape justice or strengthen her power.
